caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped box with a matching lid, both shown in a side view, separated to display the designs on each surface. The box and lid are decorated with an outdoor scene in shades of brown, tan, and muted green, with figures outlined in a reddish-brown color. The composition features several human figures, all wearing hats, engaged in various activities such as standing, sitting, and aiming rifles, alongside several dogs in different poses. The scene is set among trees with dense foliage, and includes additional landscape elements like shrubs and uneven ground. The box's lid has no decorative band at its edge, but the box itself is bordered at the top by a blue-and-white patterned trim. The background is a light beige color, and there is a small handwritten signature or inscription in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
